==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Otheruses|title of disambiguation page without parentheses included}}</nowiki></code>

===Example(s)===
When the disambiguation page title contains "(disambiguation)":

<code><nowiki>{{Otheruses|Mynock}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Otheruses|Mynock}}

<hr />
When the disambiguation page title does '''not''' contain "(disambiguation)":

<code><nowiki>{{Otheruses|title=327}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Otheruses|title=327}}

<hr />
When linking to a second disambiguation page:

<code><nowiki>{{Otheruses|Commander|more=Outlander (disambiguation)}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Otheruses|Commander|more=Outlander (disambiguation)}}

<hr />

When linking to a third disambiguation page:

<code><nowiki>{{Otheruses|Commander|more=Outlander (disambiguation)|more2=Bob (disambiguation)}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Otheruses|Commander|more=Outlander (disambiguation)|more2=Bob (disambiguation)}}
